description.zh:
服务凭证名称。
长度为1~128个字符，可包含英文字母、数字、半角句号（.）、短划线（-）和下划线（_）。
Status和ServiceCredentialName至少指定一个。
description.en: The name of the service credential. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, periods (.), hyphens (-), and underscores (_). At least one of Status and ServiceCredentialName must be specified.

description.zh:
服务凭证状态。
取值范围：Active / Inactive.
Status和ServiceCredentialName至少指定一个。
description.en:
The status of the service credential. Valid values:
- Active
- Inactive

At least one of Status and ServiceCredentialName must be specified.

description.zh:
RAM用户登录名称。
不指定表示修改当前调用身份下的服务凭证。
description.en: The logon name of the Resource Access Management (RAM) user. If this parameter is not specified, the service credential of the identity that you use to invoke this operation is modified.

title.zh: 修改服务凭证的状态或名称
title.en: Modify the status or name of a service credential

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ims update-service-credential --service-credential-id SC0000000000000000 --user-principal-name test@example.onaliyun.com --status Active --service-credential-name yourServiceCredentialName --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun ims UpdateServiceCredential --region cn-hangzhou --Status Active --UserPrincipalName 'test@example.onaliyun.com' --ServiceCredentialName yourServiceCredentialName --ServiceCredentialId SC0000000000000000
